text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You cleared "Dance Exercise: Demon Hard 
Mode"?! That's amazing! Most people give 
up halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I think it just suited my nature. 
I've always loved the feeling of winning a 
battle against myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's definitely great for muscle 
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The one and only thing I can truly be 
confident in is the intense training I've 
put myself through!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Ryan. I'm running a one-off dance 
exercise class soon. Would you want to 
join as my assistant?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
People tend to find me intimidating at 
first! But you're so approachable, so 
having you around makes everyone feel at 
ease!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Some students might fall behind midway 
through. I need you to encourage them with 
your brightness and muscle power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With my cheerful spirit and muscle 
power...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(It surprised me, but... I see. Tucker-san 
has high hopes... for me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd love to try it! I'll be in your 
care!"
